title.narrative: Support to the investment climate in the South Mediterranean region for sustainable jobs and growth

description.narrative: The Action on ¿Support to the investment climate in the South Mediterranean region for sustainable jobs and growth¿ is a regional project which aims to support sustainable growth and decent job creation through an integrated approach to improve the investment climate. The Action will contribute to enhancing the ability of South Neighbourhood countries/territories to self-assess, implement and improve investment climate reforms with a view to attract higher quality and more inclusive investment.
